(2) Look docs up fast — grep the literal term FIRST; only when grep is ambiguous (hits scattered across files / synonym mismatch / zero hits) run find_docs.py to rank the doc that owns the topic by frontmatter intent, or resolve a doc's schema_source straight to the code. Trigger phrases — "which doc covers X", "find the schema this doc points to", "where is endpoint/config-key X documented", "add OKF frontmatter to this doc", "lint the docs", "scaffold a new ADR/chapter".
